en.headline: Hong Kong beat Cambodia 2-0 to win ASEAN Challenge Cup
en.dek: Matt Orr and an Everton Camargo penalty settled the final at Kai Tak Stadium, reports said, after a June defeat in Phnom Penh.
body: Hong Kong won the first ASEAN Challenge Cup on Saturday night, beating Cambodia 2-0 in the final at Kai Tak Stadium, Sing Tao and Oriental Daily reported.

Matt Orr put Hong Kong ahead in the 41st minute, finishing a pass from Sun Ming Him, the reports said. After the break a foul in the area was reviewed by the video assistant referee, and Everton Camargo scored the penalty in the 58th minute to make it 2-0.

The result reversed a 0-2 loss away to Cambodia in June, which reports described as Hong Kong's first defeat to the side in 55 years. FIFA's match centre listed the Kai Tak fixture as the final of the tournament.
Hong Kong had reached the final after beating Brunei 2-0 earlier in the competition. Saturday's win is the side's first title in the ASEAN Challenge Cup.

zh.headline: 港隊2比0挫柬埔寨 奪首屆東盟挑戰杯
zh.dek: 啟德主場決賽由安永佳先開紀錄，艾華頓十二碼建功，報導指港隊報卻6月作客敗仗。
body: 港隊星期六晚在啟德主場體育館的東盟挑戰杯決賽以2比0擊敗柬埔寨，奪得首屆賽事冠軍，《星島頭條》及東網均有報道。
報導指，安永佳在41分鐘接應孫銘謙傳球先開紀錄。易邊後禁區內一記犯規經視像助理裁判覆核，球證判十二碼，艾華頓在58分鐘主射得手，把比分擴大至2比0。
今次作賽亦是對6月作客0比2不敵柬埔寨的回應。報導形容該仗是港隊55年來首次敗給柬埔寨。國際足協賽事中心把啟德這場列為決賽。
港隊較早前以2比0淘汰文萊晉級決賽。星期六一仗是港隊首奪東盟挑戰杯。
